description.value:
The Hydra is high-quality, high-cost, high-power, high-lethality, and easily the most comfortable auto-shotgun on the market. Yet, it doesn’t do anything special, innovative, or particularly new. To most, it’s just another milspec crowd-shredder from a veteran weapons megacorp. It’ll still turn flesh to mush, though.

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Shotgun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Shotgun Long Barrel

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 8 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Concealable: NoSlots: 0 • Attachments: Magrail Kit (w/Auto-Compensator and Vivisector), Power Rebuild, Shotgun Automatic Control Group, Shotgun Choke, Shotgun Rechamber, Sling, Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: When firing Shells with this weapon and incurring a Critical Injury, the user may roll twice on the Critical Injury table and choose one for the victim to suffer [Vivisector].

Range: Shotgun Long Barrel
Pre-installed: Magrail Kit (w/Auto-Compensator and Vivisector), Power Rebuild, Shotgun Automatic Control Group, Shotgun Choke, Shotgun Rechamber, Sling, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Foundry notes:

  • CPR 0.92.4 shows a "weapon doesn't support this mode" warning when a pistol Autofires; it's only a warning and the roll still works.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
